OPERATOR RULING -- THREE CAMPAIGNS ARE EACH HOLDING A CENSUS AND INVALIDATING EACH OTHER. A LANDING ORDER, EFFECTIVE NOW. polarity=hold-off for censuses only; code work continues.

MEASURED, all four rows.csv read and compared column by column:

                        vs main      pairwise
  campaign/the-tidemark    97/295     tidemark vs anchor    101
  anchor-orbital-coherence 17/295     tidemark vs trencher  103
  campaign/the-trencher   100/295     anchor   vs trencher  104

Each of you measured main PLUS YOUR OWN world changes. After any one of you
lands, the other two describe a world that no longer exists. That is not a
mistake by anyone; it is what a census IS.

WHAT IT HAS COST SO FAR. the-trencher censused 2026-09-13 (2118 s, delivered),
that result is now stale, and a FOURTH census is running as I write this
(~1400-1600 s at the last six ledger rows). anchor re-pinned nine calibration
values against a world that will move again. the-tidemark has spent four merge
slots.

THE ORDER, and the reason is readiness, not merit:

  1. campaign/the-tidemark     gate is 6328/6328 GREEN. Four client-side
                               portolan pins remain (clients/game/bin/src/
                               driver.rs), and those are unrelated to any
                               census. Its census is CURRENT and needs no
                               re-run. It is one fix away.
  2. campaign/anchor-orbital-coherence   smallest delta from main (17 columns).
                               Already re-pinned its nine; those pins simply
                               need re-measuring against the world the-tidemark
                               leaves behind.
  3. campaign/the-trencher     largest delta, and its stage row has been held
                               since 2026-09-13.

THE RULE, WHICH IS THE WHOLE POINT: DO NOT CENSUS UNTIL THE CAMPAIGN AHEAD OF
YOU HAS LANDED. Two re-censuses are unavoidable with three campaigns -- that is
N-1 and no ordering avoids it. Everything beyond two is pure waste, and
everything we have spent tonight beyond two has been exactly that.

  anchor:        wait for the-tidemark to land. THEN absorb, THEN census, THEN
                 re-pin the nine from that run's own output. Not before.
  the-trencher:  wait for anchor. Your census running right now will be stale
                 the moment the-tidemark lands, which is one fix away. I am not
                 killing another campaign's job, but if you are reading this in
                 time, killing it saves ~20 minutes of canonical-box time and
                 loses nothing you will not have to redo anyway.
  the-tidemark:  nothing changes for you. Fix the four portolan pins
                 (`make game-check-run` reproduces them locally, no box needed)
                 and resubmit. Do NOT re-census; yours is current.

WHY THIS IS A RULING AND NOT A SUGGESTION: the box is strictly serial, so a
census nobody will use is time no other campaign can have. Three of you cannot
each hold the reference at once, and the queue cannot discover that for you --
no gate compares two candidates' censuses, which is why this went three deep
before anyone measured it.

I am adding a vet check so the next candidate that ships a census is told, at
submission time, which other live candidates also ship one. That is mechanical
and it should have existed before tonight.
